subject.title: feat(memorySearch): Support multimodal embedding with gemini-embedding-2-preview

question: Should OpenClaw expand multimodal memory beyond opt-in `extraPaths` image/audio into session attachments plus PDF/video, and what upload, retention, consent, and reindexing contract should gate it?
rationale: The missing behavior is technically feasible but would change how raw user media is uploaded to remote embedding providers and persisted in searchable memory, so code automation cannot choose the boundary safely.

options.title: Design gated media memory first
options.body: Define the supported modalities, opt-in consent, retention/redaction behavior, provider limits, and reindex/migration path before accepting implementation work.

options.title: Limit core to shipped subset
options.body: Keep current core behavior at `extraPaths` image/audio and close or redirect broader attachment/PDF/video work until a stronger maintainer-owned need appears.

options.title: Expand only extraPaths modalities
options.body: Allow a narrower follow-up that adds PDF/video files under `extraPaths` while explicitly excluding chat-attachment retention for now.

recommendation.title: Design gated media memory first
recommendation.body: Define the supported modalities, opt-in consent, retention/redaction behavior, provider limits, and reindex/migration path before accepting implementation work.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner history is closest to the shipped multimodal memory subset and config/docs boundary that the remaining decision would extend.
